title: runic.translations.status/1
description: The payload of runic-translations status inside the runic.commandline/1 envelope of --format json; also fault.data when a locale is below its --min-coverage (exit 1). Later releases may add properties; readers ignore properties they do not know.

belowThreshold.description: Whether any locale is below its --min-coverage.

project.description: The project's runic.json, relative to the working directory where possible.

messages.description: The base locale's messages: the total of every locale.

locales.description: The base locale first, then the others by tag.

reviewFile.description: The review file that stale counts come from; absent when it does not exist.

fallbackLocale.description: The locale it falls back to; absent for the base locale.

fallback.description: Messages a fallback locale other than the base locale serves.

missing.description: Messages shown in the base locale.

coverage.description: Translated plus fallback, as a percentage of messages, rounded down to two decimals.

stale.description: Translations whose source changed since the review file recorded them; absent without a review file and for the base locale.

minimumCoverage.description: The --min-coverage that applies to the locale.
